title: Traditional British Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting beef stew recipe from the UK, perfect for a cold evening. The long cooking time tenderizes the beef to perfection.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, browned beef, carrots, potatoes, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the flour to thicken.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
